options.reason: The table is a TCGA gene-expression matrix with ~17.8k gene-level features plus a five-level PAM50 annotation, so the evident intended task is multiclass subtype prediction from expression; sample_id is a row key only and no column encodes or derives from PAM50, so nothing must be blocked as leakage. Model selection happens within TCGA and a single external evaluation is done on CPTAC (which lacks the Normal-like class), which is a held-out evaluation detail rather than a schema field.
options.title: multiclass
